subject: Downstream vendor permission query — payments integrator request
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@paymentsintegrator.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@paymentsintegrator.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: downstream vendor disclosures and onward-transfer permissions

Hi Karthik,

We're running a routine compliance review ahead of our Q4 rollouts and need to confirm Redwood's current stance on downstream transfers and subprocessor disclosures. Specifically: 

- A current vendor roster (including cloud providers, monitoring/analytics partners, long-term storage providers).
- Which subprocessors are permitted to perform onward transfers to third parties (e.g., analytics partners, research collaborators).
- Evidence that SCCs or equivalent mechanisms are in place for EU data flows.
- A point of contact to request SOC 2 or SIG evidence under NDA if required.

Can you attach a recent vendor list and indicate whether StreamLens (our analytics partner) is considered an allowed recipient under your DPA/SCCs? We aim to close this request in two business days if possible.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Senior Compliance Manager
Payments Integrator Inc.
elena.ruiz@paymentsintegrator.com
+44 20 7123 4567

[No attachments]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@paymentsintegrator.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: downstream vendor disclosures and onward-transfer permissions

Elena — thanks for the clear list. I'm looping in Neha (privacy & vendor ops) and Marissa (legal lead for DPAs) so we can assemble the roster and the supporting evidence. A few quick clarifying q's so we provide exactly what you need: 

1) When you say "StreamLens (analytics partner)" — do you need a statement that Redwood allows onward transfers to StreamLens specifically, or confirmation that Redwood permits downstream analytics partners generally and would provide SCCs for those flows?

2) Is the scope limited to EU personal data covered by SCCs, or do you also need a list of subprocessors for non-EU regions?

We can provide an updated roster and our standard DPA summary today, and Neha can follow up with any SCC execution evidence. If you need SOC 2 under NDA we can route that through our security team.

Karthik
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[Attachment: request_checklist.txt]
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@paymentsintegrator.com>

Cc: compliance@paymentsintegrator.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: downstream vendor disclosures and onward-transfer permissions

Karthik — thanks. Please: 

- Confirm whether StreamLens is explicitly listed/approved. If not, confirm whether Redwood's DPA permits such an onward transfer when requested by a controller (and whether SCCs are applied).
- We only need EU scope for this request.
- Please include timestamps/last-updated on any roster you provide.

If you can provide a redacted roster and a short note on SCC status today that will be sufficient for our intake team; we'll request SOC 2 under NDA if we see any gaps.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Elena
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@paymentsintegrator.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: downstream vendor disclosures and onward-transfer permissions

Elena — attaching our latest subprocessor roster and short evidence bundle. Summary answers below and items attached.

Summary (EU scope):
- Current roster last updated: 2026-08-15 (attached: redwood_subprocessor_roster_2026-08.pdf). Roster is redacted to remove internal contact emails for public share; full version available on NDA.
- StreamLens (analytics.partner.com) — listed as a supported subprocessor for non-identifiable telemetry and aggregated analytics only. Onward transfers of personal data to third parties are permitted only where covered by our DPA/SCCs and after a controller-level authorization. In short: StreamLens is not an open-ended onward transfer recipient for EU personal data without contractual controls.
- SCC status: We execute EU SCCs by amendment to our DPA when EU personal data is involved. Evidence: attached scc-execution-log_2026-08.txt (redacted audit trail). For full executed agreements we require a signed DPA amendment or an NDA to provide copies.
- SOC 2 / SIG: Available on request under NDA; please confirm your preferred transfer method and a contact for our security team.

Attachments included: redwood_subprocessor_roster_2026-08.pdf; scc-execution-log_2026-08.txt; dpa_summary_v2.docx

Next steps: If Payments Integrator needs a signed copy of the SCCs or the unredacted roster, Marissa can coordinate the DPA amendment/recipient agreement; please advise if you'd like Marissa to open the amendment now.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Privacy & Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
